name: Google Drive MCP
description: Google Drive integration for storing and retrieving resumes, cover letter templates, and evaluation reports. Keeps tailored CV versions organised per application.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search Drive for resume or cover letter files

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Save a new tailored resume or cover letter

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy resume template to create a job-specific version

tools.name: download_file_content
tools.description: Download a file for local use

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: Check file metadata (name, modified date, size)

tools.name: list_recent_files
tools.description: List recently accessed resume or report files

notes: Authenticated via Google OAuth. Convention: store resumes as 'Resume - [Company] - [Role] - [Date].md' in a /career-ops folder on Drive.

changelog.notes: Initial Google Drive MCP for resume and document management.
